name: IHI Forum 2026
description: The Institute for Healthcare Improvement holds its 2026 National Forum at the Phoenix Convention Center in Phoenix, Arizona. The Forum covers quality improvement and patient safety in healthcare.

deadlines.label: Early registration
deadlines.note: General Conference (December 8 to 9) rate of $1,395 available until this date

notes: One indexed page snippet referenced an Anaheim Convention Center in connection with the Forum, which appears to be a stale or mismatched cached fragment; all other sources consistently confirm Phoenix, Arizona for the 2026 Forum.
